about_the_game:
The heartbeat of these girls will eventually become a melody that changes the world.

NonetBeat is a third-person shooter (TPS) action game woven together by three adorable heroines.

World Setting

The stage is a world where a goddess has granted magical powers to nearly all of this world, there are girls called "Outcasts" who were not bestowed with magical abilities.Even so, they wish to be of help to someone and throw themselves into battle as soldiers.Disasters caused by an increasing number of monsters, ongoing conflicts among people—what fate awaits these girls?

Key Features

  • Sandbox-Style Blocks: The stages are entirely made of destructible blocks. Experience dynamic battles while destroying terrain and structures.

  • Hack & Slash: The protagonist’s weapons and power-ups are all obtained through items. Discover unique items with special effects tailored just for you.

  • Your Own Tactics: The game features over 100 types of magic (weapons), but you can only bring two into battle. Choose carefully based on the stage layout and your strategy.

  • Distinct Protagonists: While the three heroines can use the same magic, their unique abilities lead to different combat styles.

Add NonetBeat to your wishlist and support its journey to completion!

short_description: NonetBeat is a TPS action game starring three charming heroines. Each with unique combat styles, they obliterate hordes of monsters with magic! Sandbox stages let you destroy terrain for dynamic battles. Collect magic and unleash dazzling combos in thrilling hack-and-slash action!
